name: re-discipline
description: Disciplined, evidence-based knowledge management for reverse-engineering and research projects. Core rule: where a file lives tells you how much to trust it -- provisional work in active/, facts verified by DIRECT evidence in docs/truth/ (nothing becomes 'truth' without it -- the 'Wall'), finished investigations written up as chronicles in docs/history/. You work in 'campaigns': open an investigation, optionally delegate parts to subagents, review their findings against the Wall, promote only what's proven, then close it into a chronicle. Includes an optional lifecycle for hiring external AI agents (Codex, Gemini, local models) as research drafters. Run /init-project to add the whole structure to any repo -- the generic method stays in the plugin; your project's mission and specifics live in a project profile.
